Our bridal party swung into action calling all our vendors to relocate to where I, the bride, stayed the night prior. Jake arrived with energy and enthusiasm, lifting all our spirits.

Our ceremony went off without a hitch - we even noticed the finest detail of our wedding certificate location being updated! He thought of everything whilst we were in a state of shock and the day went by in a blur. Words cannot describe how grateful we are for everything he did to make our Plan B (that was planned in mere hours) run even better than our original plans.

After our ceremony, Jake helped ferry our guests through the rain to the local pub and ensured everyone was seated with a hot meal and drink in hand. What could’ve been a disaster turned out to be a dream wedding that we’ll never forget.

children.text: We cannot thank Jake enough for all the effort and energy he put into our special day. We couldn’t have imagined it without him. He made our ceremony so personal, relaxed and enjoyable for my husband and myself, plus our guests.

If you are looking for a celebrant then settle in to read this novel because you aren’t going to read any more reviews after this! My husband and I eloped to Maleny after COVID did us a bamboozle. Leading up to the day, so many things had gone wrong and on the day we were standing on a hilltop before the ceremony and it was overcast, super windy and our son suddenly burst into tears because he inexplicably, right in that moment, terribly missed our dog!

I was standing before the love of my life, about to confess my undying love for him and vow to be with him the rest of my life, but I’ll tell you because I’m a frank kind of gal, I was DONE. I wanted to just hurry up and wife this dude and get off that hilltop.

Now this is why you NEED Jake as your celebrant - he saved our wedding day. He is a magician, I tell you! I was standing on that hilltop just wanting to get this thing done already, but Jake managed to create something truly special and beautiful for us. He is an amazingly personable man and he was able to bring out all the love and laughter in mine and my now husband’s relationship, despite our frustrations with events leading up to the ceremony.

With immense warmth and charisma, he reiterated for us why we were doing this and created a bubble for my man and I to really cherish each other, to hell with the weather and wind and everything else! It was so natural and beautiful that my man, who I’ve only seen cry twice in the 5 years I’ve been with him, was crying during Jake’s words. Jake is also super intuitive and got us to have a hug mid ceremony because we were both becoming a crying mess.

He was also mindful of his placement for the best possible photos, which I didn’t even think of. His attention to detail is fantastic. He was also an absolute gem entertaining our son after the ceremony so our photographer could get some nice shots of us on the hilltop.

This man was made to do weddings and my husband and I could not stop gushing to each other about how great he was. I can’t even imagine how amazing Jake would be in a ceremony with guests, because he is the right amount of entertaining while still making everything about the love between the two people standing in front of him. If you are worried about an awkward, stiff ceremony then put your trust in Jake because he will not disappoint you.

To finish this novel of a review off, I just want to ensure you don’t think Jake has employed bots to write reviews as part of a rigorous marketing overhaul - I am very much a newlywed sitting here sipping coffee with her husband the morning after her wedding, eternally grateful to one incredible celebrant.

I honestly cannot begin to express how amazing Jake was throughout our entire wedding process. In terms of planning our day, Jake made every step so smooth and simple, and for two people who really struggle with making final decisions, this was invaluable to us!

From helping us organise the ceremony to giving us advice on how to write our vows, to providing suggestions on how to improve the run sheet - Jake was there every step of the way and made everything so easy.

On the actual day, we received non-stop compliments on how amazing Jake was. Our guests could not stop raving about how effortlessly funny he was, and how he really brought the energy to our ceremony and reception.

Jake honestly went above and beyond for us, checking in constantly to see how we were feeling and to make sure we were enjoying ourselves, and also offering to run to the 7/11 to get more batteries for our camera! You could tell he was there to ensure everything was about my husband and I and that we were at the centre of every decision he made, and we can’t thank him enough for that.
We will recommend Jake as a celebrant/MC to anyone who will listen. Thanks so much for everything!

The whole end-to-end experience with Jake was phenomenal. It was efficient and easy, but Jake was also fun, personal and reliable. We could not have been happier with having Jake as our celebrant for our wedding and would highly recommend him to others on the hunt.

We asked for a fun, joyful and heartfelt ceremony and that was exactly what Jake delivered for us. Plus, all our guests were raving about how great the whole experience was for them as well. Thank you Jake!

We were blown away by how great you were and how you made it all so fun whilst ensuring everything flowed smoothly. So many of our guests mentioned how impressed they were with our celebrant/MC and everyone kept asking who you were and where we found you. My brother even asked if you travel interstate for weddings as he’s due to get married in the next year or two.

We were very impressed with how you remembered minor details we mentioned and incorporated them into your commentary. Everything ran so smoothly and your reassurance, tips and advice on the day made it so much less stressful.

We also appreciated your encouragement to play a game at the reception as it made it so enjoyable for everyone - we had such great feedback! It was wonderful not having to worry about finding an MC within our friends or family group, so your celebrant and MC package was incredibly convenient!
Jake is fantastic! We had Jake marry us at our June wedding, and all throughout the Covid-19 outbreak, he was there every step of the way with guidance, encouragement and support.
Our wedding day was absolutely perfect, and Jake delivered a heartfelt, loving, honest and funny ceremony. All of our guests have commented on how amazing the ceremony was.
We have already recommended him to friends for their wedding!

Jake was nothing short of incredible! From the very beginning of planning our day right through to the final moments, he made the entire process feel effortless. His communication was exceptional - prompt, clear, and always reassuring.

On the big day, he brought such a calm and confident presence that instantly put us at ease. As our MC, it honestly felt like he’d known us for years. He captured our vibe perfectly and made everything flow seamlessly.
It was such a relief knowing we didn’t have to worry about a thing - Jake had it all under control. We truly couldn’t recommend him more highly!
Braeside at Gin House Creek Estate
Six years on and I still can’t quite find the words to describe how incredible Jake was as our celebrant, but here goes…

From the moment we stumbled across him in a story our wedding venue had shared, we just knew he was the one. We sent an enquiry and within minutes, Jake had replied with a personalised video message introducing himself — such a small gesture, but it made such a big impression. We met up shortly after, and although he encouraged us to meet with other celebrants, our minds were already made up. His warmth, wit, and that unmistakable “Jake vibe” had us hooked.

But what truly set Jake apart was how he carried us through one of the most difficult times in our lives. Just five days before our wedding, my dad passed away suddenly and unexpectedly. It was heartbreaking, and we honestly didn’t know how the day would unfold.

Jake handled the situation with such empathy and grace — acknowledging the elephant in the room and giving everyone permission to feel both the sadness of loss and the joy of celebration. It was exactly what we all needed. He brought light, humour, and genuine care to our ceremony, making it both deeply personal and full of heart.

Even now, six years later, people still tell us how beautiful and authentic our ceremony was — and that’s all thanks to Jake. Jake, you weren’t just our celebrant; you were our calm in the storm, our storyteller, and the reason our ceremony felt so “us.” We’ll never forget it.
